services.s1Body: Bilingual, fast, accessible sites on modern frameworks — not page builders. Content you can update yourself.

services.howBody: Fixed scope, written estimate, code you own. If your budget is better spent elsewhere, we say so before you sign.

eco.title: Software should remove something real.
eco.body: We choose projects that take something out of the physical world: vehicles off the road, trips made to obtain information that should be a click away, paper printed to move a file across a desk. It guides what we agree to build. It is not a sales argument.
eco.i2l: Information online instead of over a counter
eco.i3l: Files that move without being printed
eco.fine: we sell no carbon credits and we offset nothing. No product of ours will display avoided tonnes without its calculation method published beside the figure. If a project would not reduce anything measurable, we will say so rather than dress it in green.

about.bio1: Based in Oshawa, Magloire works at the intersection of technology and community development in Durham Region. He also leads NAPECA, an organization dedicated to international municipal cooperation, and works in both French and English.
about.bio2: NATAIS was incorporated federally on 20 August 2026 to carry this work as a company rather than a series of side projects.
about.sensibility: Sustainable development, the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions and the protection of the environment are not a section of our website; they are a filter on what we agree to build. Digital tools are good at removing journeys, paper and waiting — that is where we would rather spend our time. When a product of ours claims an environmental effect, it publishes the method behind the figure.
about.identifiersLede: Publicly verifiable in the Corporations Canada register. We publish them because partners and funders check.
about.not1: Claim client references we do not have. Everything here is our own work, and labelled as such.
about.not2: Sell automation that will not pay for itself. The audit exists to tell you when the answer is no.
about.not3: Hold your code hostage. You own what we build for you.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: This site collects nothing except what you type into the contact form: your name, your organization if you give one, your email address, the subject you choose and your message. That information is sent to us by email so that we can answer you. It is not sold, not shared, and not used for advertising.
privacy.p2: We keep contact messages for as long as the exchange is useful, and no longer. You may ask us at any time to delete what you sent, by writing to contact@natais.ca.
privacy.p3: The site sets no advertising cookies and runs no third-party tracking. Your language preference is the only thing kept in your browser, and only so that the site opens in the language you chose.
privacy.p4: Our products — CarpoolWork in particular — have their own privacy policies, because they handle different data. This page covers this website only.
